text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Air Groove is hard at work, her old acquaintance Silence Suzuka is also garnering attention from the racing world at large.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them enter a scrimmage, where Air Groove loses utterly to this Umamusume known as the Otherworldly Front-Runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Identifying Silence Suzuka as a major obstacle to overcome, Air Groove makes it her next goal to defeat her at the Osaka Hai.
